kind: Synthetic rubric evaluation. Treat supplied evidence summaries as stipulated facts.

No real PROD readiness, risk acceptance, or authorization is supplied.

cases.request: Apply the release-confidence decision model to this stipulated assessment summary.

facts.system_impact: The selected release changes a shared authentication dependency used by every service.
facts.evidence: Direct current evidence supports every material condition. Whole-release, real-service integration and recovery results match candidate identities and target conditions.
facts.policy: All applicable conditions are met. No material unresolved risk, unsupported exception, or missing required approval remains.

facts.business_impact: A release delay preserves a documented customer defect until the next operating window.
facts.system_impact: Application code can roll back, but the candidate writes an irreversible data format.
facts.evidence: Direct current execution demonstrates duplicate financial records under a required retry case. No reconciliation or data recovery procedure exists.
facts.controls: An alert detects duplicate writes after persistence. Code rollback does not remove those writes.
facts.policy: The documented mandatory integrity condition prohibits duplicate records. No applicable exception exists.
